tools.name: find_city
tools.description: Look up a supported city by name (e.g. "Lahore", "Birmingham UK", "new york"). Returns slugs for the other tools, coordinates, time zone and the country's default method and Asr school, or close matches for misspellings.

tools.name: get_prayer_times
tools.description: Fajr, sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha for today and the next 7 days in the city's local time, the next prayer, and Asr for the other school.

tools.name: get_monthly_timetable
tools.description: Daily prayer times for a whole month, from two months back to twelve months ahead of the city's current month.

tools.name: get_qibla
tools.description: Qibla bearing from true north, compass point and great-circle distance to the Kaaba for a city.

tools.name: get_islamic_dates
tools.description: Expected dates of Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, the Day of Arafah, Islamic New Year, Ashura, Mawlid, Isra and Mi‘raj, Shab-e-Barat and Laylat al-Qadr in a Gregorian year (Umm al-Qura), with a note on countries that are often a day later.

tools.name: list_calculation_methods
tools.description: The calculation methods (Fajr and Isha angles) and each country's default method and Asr school.
